text: Got it (TCL68). Heads up: the chat moves to the other Claude account (acct-5d1e2d) at 7:20pm ET, so use that account for chat after then; everything is in the repo for it. What I already found in PropLine's archive (90 days, Novig + Pinnacle, real results): (1) prop Overs flagged +EV lose 6-14% (kills those); (2) game totals bought at a Novig price Pinnacle's close beats by 2%+: +9.6% over 1,471 bets (t 3.2, both date halves positive); (3) prop Unders flagged +2%: +7% (t 1.9, not yet enough); (4) TIMING: with the 'early open' bets at 72h+ out earning +13.5% (t 3.5, both halves) and late ones (<6h) losing: but that is when Novig first posted a price, not when the engine would detect it, so I'm building the right test now: for each finished game, Novig's actual price at 72/48/24/12/6/3/1 hours before the start vs Pinnacle's close and the result (PropLine's /odds/history), run free on GitHub. That decides the trap guard and the bid timing with real evidence.
